searchText: Maybe of interest -- a spreadsheet with number of bids, and incremental value bids, across all relays, for 1k slots: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1oxNyT1Q3GaHQBXmLBxulkDosFTIXH9HgF2m5ICMXxN0/edit#gid=0 Would love to hear the opinion of everyone here about removing the Bellatrix types and code-paths from mev-boost. - Pro: would make the code a lot cleaner, and smaller, and updates easier - Con: ? (do we need it for testing in the future) I'm waiting to do so for Gnosis to transition to capella mainnet For Nimbus. But I'm for it, in general
